overall.title: Strongly Positive Among Spice Seekers
overall.subtitle: Praised for balanced 'sweet heat' and cocktail versatility; mild reservations from purists and some availability hurdles.

platformSentiments.title: Blogs & Review Sites
platformSentiments.description: Consistently positive. Reviewers highlight real but balanced heat, pleasant sweetness, and that it’s not a gimmick. Often described as sippable and great in cocktails.

platformSentiments.title: Reddit & Forums
platformSentiments.description: Heat is present but manageable—“not a capsaicin bomb.” Spice lovers approve; tequila purists are lukewarm but not negative. Comparisons note Ghost as less vegetal than jalapeño-forward rivals.

platformSentiments.title: Tequila Matchmaker
platformSentiments.description: Community rating around 76/100 and expert panel ~71/100 indicate mild approval and an average base tequila; concept seen as niche but respectable.

platformSentiments.title: Cocktail Use & Trade
platformSentiments.description: Elevates drinks like Palomas by adding chili spice without overpowering flavors; bartenders enjoy recommending and working with it.

platformSentiments.title: Value for Money
platformSentiments.description: Typically $25–$30; seen as a good deal and cheaper than Tanteo. Little to no price complaints; often called worth the hunt if you like spicy drinks.

platformSentiments.title: Availability & Confusion
platformSentiments.description: Can be hard to find locally; many order online. Some confusion with a different “Ghost Edition” bottle (Gran Agave) occasionally misdirects negative feedback.

platformSentiments.title: Comparisons
platformSentiments.description: Versus Tanteo Jalapeño: less green/vegetal, cleaner heat with subtle fruit. Versus 21 Seeds Cucumber Jalapeño: bolder and spicier (higher ABV), better for those seeking punch.

quotes.text: The verdict? Bomb. ...Surprisingly sweet flavor to start, immediately replaced by the [Bloody Mary-like] taste... A spice definitely lingers... none of it is overwhelming – it’s what you would hope for.
The pepper is fortunately manageable - hot, but not overwhelming... a classic 'sweet heat' experience.
We could definitely sip this straight... It's nice and peppery, but also retains that banana-like sweetness... the finish follows through sweet, with a slight chili burn.
not a 'hey ghost pepperz here lol' kinda crap; it's actually got a rip to it... nice kick
Be prepared to put in extra effort to find it, as Ghost isn't as widely available as other tequilas... it's worth the hunt.
'upped the game' in a Paloma cocktail, adding delicious chili spice without overpowering the grapefruit.

closingText: Overall sentiment skews strongly positive for its intended audience: a balanced, flavorful heat that shines in cocktails at a fair price, with only mild pushback from purists and some availability-related friction.
